nodes.description: Public constant string state variable 'symbol' = "U3D".
Public constant string state variable 'name' = "unity3d".
Public constant uint8 state variable 'decimals' = 1.
Private constant uint __totalSupply = 12800000, the fixed token supply.
Private mapping(address => uint) __balanceOf holding token balances.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) __allowances holding spending approvals.
Constructor Unity3d() that assigns the whole __totalSupply to __balanceOf[msg.sender].
totalSupply() constant returns the constant __totalSupply.
balanceOf(address _addr) constant returns __balanceOf[_addr].
transfer(address _to, uint _value) moves tokens from msg.sender to _to after a balance check.
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) moves tokens using the msg.sender allowance; performs unchecked subtractions on balances and allowance.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) sets __allowances[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant returns __allowances[_owner][_spender].
msg.sender, attacker-controllable caller identity used for balances, allowances and authorization.
Unchecked subtraction __balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value inside transfer (arithmetic).
Unchecked addition __balanceOf[_to] += _value inside transfer (arithmetic).
Unchecked subtraction __balanceOf[_from] -= _value inside transferFrom (arithmetic).
Unchecked addition __balanceOf[_to] += _value inside transferFrom (arithmetic).
Unchecked subtraction __allowances[_from][msg.sender] -= _value inside transferFrom (arithmetic).
Parameter _addr of balanceOf, the account queried.
Parameter _to of transfer, the recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer, the amount moved.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, the amount moved.
Parameter _spender of approve.
Parameter _value of approve, the allowance amount.
Parameter _owner of allowance.
Parameter _spender of allowance.
Named return variable _totalSupply assigned in totalSupply().

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by the constructor to seed the initial balance.
Constructor writes __balanceOf[msg.sender] = __totalSupply.
Constructor reads the constant __totalSupply to mint the supply.
totalSupply reads and returns the constant __totalSupply.
balanceOf reads __balanceOf[_addr].
transfer invokes balanceOf(msg.sender) as its guard before mutating balances.
transfer authorizes the debit purely from msg.sender identity, which is untrusted input.
transfer executes the unchecked subtraction __balanceOf[msg.sender] -= _value.
transfer executes the unchecked addition __balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Unsafe subtraction writes into the __balanceOf mapping.
Unsafe addition writes into the __balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads __allowances[_from][msg.sender] for its guard.
transferFrom reads __balanceOf[_from] for its guard.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction __balanceOf[_from] -= _value.
transferFrom executes the unchecked addition __balanceOf[_to] += _value.
transferFrom executes the unchecked subtraction __allowances[_from][msg.sender] -= _value.
Unsafe subtraction writes into the __balanceOf mapping from transferFrom.
Unsafe addition writes into the __balanceOf mapping from transferFrom.
Unsafe subtraction writes into the __allowances mapping from transferFrom.
transferFrom treats msg.sender as the spender whose allowance authorizes the transfer.
approve writes __allowances[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
approve sets an allowance keyed by the untrusted msg.sender.
allowance reads __allowances[_owner][_spender].
Parameter _addr indexes the __balanceOf lookup in balanceOf.
Parameter _to is used as the recipient in transfer.
Parameter _value is used as the amount in transfer.
Parameter _value is the operand of the unchecked sender-balance subtraction.
Parameter _value is the operand of the unchecked recipient-balance addition.
Parameter _from is used as the debited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _to is used as the credited account in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is used as the amount in transferFrom.
Parameter _value is the operand of the unchecked balance subtraction in transferFrom.
Parameter _spender indexes the allowance written by approve.
Parameter _value is the allowance amount written by approve.
Parameter _owner indexes the allowance read by allowance.
Parameter _spender indexes the allowance read by allowance.
Named return variable _totalSupply is assigned in totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: The _addr parameter only serves the balanceOf lookup and should be folded into the balanceOf function node.
The _to parameter has no independent semantics outside transfer and can be merged into it.
The _value parameter is only consumed by transfer's balance check and updates and can be normalized into the transfer function.
The _from parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom's allowance and balance logic.
The _to parameter exists solely as the recipient argument of transferFrom.
The _value parameter directly parameterizes the unchecked subtraction of the sender balance, so it merges into that unsafe operation.
The _spender parameter is only used to index the allowance written by approve.
The _value parameter is only used as the stored allowance in approve.
The _owner parameter is only used as a lookup key in allowance.
The _spender parameter is only used as a lookup key in allowance.
The named return variable _totalSupply is a temporary holder for the constant returned by totalSupply.
